name: manufacturing-uns
description: Local dev — three terminals from repo root: npm run stack, npm run sim, npm run ui

scripts.stack: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build --scale uns_simulator=0
scripts.sim: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up uns_simulator
scripts.down: uv run uns_compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
